name: OHLC Check
summary: This EA is a data validation utility that checks OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) price data for integrity and consistency across the broker's price feed. It monitors for irregularities such as high<low violations, gap detection, and timestamp anomalies, alerting the user when data quality issues are found.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个数据验证工具，用于检查OHLC（开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价）数据的完整性和一致性。它监控数据异常如最高价低于最低价、价格缺口和时间戳问题，在发现数据质量问题时向用户发出警报。
strategy_analysis: 此EA不执行交易策略，而是一个数据质量检查工具。它的核心功能是验证每个K线的OHLC数据是否符合基本逻辑规则，例如最高价必须大于等于最低价、开盘价和收盘价必须在最高价和最低价之间。它还会检测K线之间的价格跳空、时间戳连续性以及数据缺失问题。仓位管理方面不适用，因为该工具不会开仓。资金管理同样不适用。当检测到异常数据时，EA会通过警报、日志或界面提示用户，帮助交易者避免因数据错误导致的交易决策失误。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not execute any trading strategy; it is a data quality validation tool. Its core function is verifying that each candle's OHLC data conforms to basic logical rules, such as High must be greater than or equal to Low, and Open and Close must fall between High and Low. It also detects price gaps between consecutive candles, timestamp continuity issues, and missing data. Position sizing is not applicable since the tool never opens positions. Money management is similarly not applicable. When anomalous data is detected, the EA alerts the user via notifications, logs, or on-chart displays, helping traders avoid making flawed trading decisions based on corrupted price data.

parameters.name: LogToFile
parameters.description: 将检查结果记录到文件
parameters.description_en: 将检查结果记录到文件

pros: 帮助交易者发现数据源异常，避免基于错误数据做出交易决策
可以实时监控价格数据质量，及时发现经纪商数据问题
作为辅助工具与其他EA配合使用，提高整体交易系统可靠性
pros_en: Helps traders detect data feed anomalies, preventing trading decisions based on corrupted data
Provides real-time monitoring of price data quality, promptly identifying broker data issues
Serves as a complementary tool alongside other EAs, improving overall trading system reliability
cons: 不产生交易利润，纯粹是辅助诊断工具
可能产生过多警报，特别是在流动性低的市场时段
无法修复数据问题，仅能检测和报告
cons_en: Does not generate trading profits; purely a diagnostic utility tool
May produce excessive alerts, especially during low-liquidity market sessions
Cannot fix data issues; only detects and reports them
improvements: 增加自动切换到备用数据源的功能
添加数据质量统计报告和历史异常记录图表
improvements_en: Add functionality to automatically switch to a backup data feed when issues are detected
Add data quality statistical reports and a historical anomaly chart
Support simultaneous monitoring of multiple symbols

risk_points: 纯检测工具无交易风险
频繁警报可能导致交易者忽略重要通知
risk_points_en: Pure detection tool with no trading risk
Frequent alerts may cause traders to ignore important notifications
